title: Successfully fixed records can be labeled as deferred uncertain
reasoning: Any revalidation decision using `COMMIT_AND_ADVANCE` unconditionally sets `record["deferred_uncertain"] = True`. That action is also the natural successful transition for a fixed finding, so fixed records can carry false uncertainty metadata into completion proof records.
reproduction: Mock a normal fix whose revalidation outcome is `fixed`, allow the transition to commit and advance, and inspect the returned record.
recommendation: Set `deferred_uncertain` only when the actual revalidation outcome is `uncertain` and advancing uncertainty was explicitly enabled.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included runner tests exercise transition behavior independently but do not assert metadata returned by the queue processing path.
suggestedRegressionTest: Cover both `fixed` and advanced `uncertain` outcomes, asserting the field is absent or false for fixed and true only for uncertain.
minimumFixScope: Condition the assignment in `_impl_process_finding_until_fixed` and add focused queue-record tests.
